treatment_summary: The plan addresses secondary prevention of ASCVD, hypertension, type 2 diabetes and hypertriglyceridaemia. Aspirin, high‑intensity atorvastatin (with ezetimibe and possible PCSK9‑i) provide intensive lipid and antiplatelet therapy per NICE CG126. Ramipril and bisoprolol treat post‑MI cardioprotection and hypertension; amlodipine and indapamide are added sequentially if BP targets are not met (NG136). Metformin and dapagliflozin manage diabetes and confer additional CV benefit (NG106). Fenofibrate is reserved for severe hypertriglyceridaemia after lifestyle optimisation. All drugs are checked for interactions and contraindications, with monitoring and baseline investigations outlined.
